description:
Returns all 12 Berlin boroughs (Bezirke) with IDs and names.

Key response fields: array of { bezirk_id, bezirk_name }
- bezirk_id: 2 digits ("01" to "12")
- bezirk_name: e.g. "Mitte", "Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg", "Pankow"

Use when:
- You need an overview of Berlin's administrative structure
- You need a bezirk_id for market data queries

Do NOT use when:
- You already know the bezirk_id → use berlin_borough_details directly
name: berlin_boroughs
title: Berlin Boroughs
